controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Relative brightness from the 2023 Cassini shape/albedo model, normalized near one; not natural color or measured geometric albedo. Cells with fewer than five images or no maplet are marked missing. The 3,500-face display approximates the source shape; map detail is finer than the displayed geometry.

controls.label: Radial height
controls.description: Q512 model radius minus a 106.5 km sphere, in km; not a geoid or independent altimetry. The paired 2023 model is less certain in poorly imaged regions; unsupported cells are marked. The 3,500-face display approximates the source shape; map detail is finer than the displayed geometry.

controls.label: Maplet resolution
controls.description: Finest contributing SPC maplet spacing in each 1° cell, in m/vertex. Smaller values mean finer local input, not guaranteed height accuracy. Cells without a maplet are marked missing.
controls.summary: Finest contributing SPC maplet spacing in each 1° cell, in m/vertex. Smaller values mean finer local input, not guaranteed height accuracy. Cells without a maplet are marked missing.

controls.label: Image count
controls.description: Contributing image count in each 1° source cell. Zero remains visible; fewer than five images warrants caution. Many images can share viewing geometry, so count alone does not establish accuracy.

controls.label: Infrared
controls.description: A small region from Cassini’s 11 June 2004 flyby, supported by 41 original VIMS pixels. False color assigns red to about 2.02 µm, green to 1.59 µm and blue to 1.28 µm. All three channels share a 0–0.03 I/F display range and gamma 2.2; this stretch changes the display only. No photometric correction is applied, so illumination remains. Archive noise filtering and local replacement are retained; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps. Placement is coarse on the existing shape, with several-kilometer spatial uncertainty. Fine surface positions are not established.
controls.summary: False-color 2.02/1.59/1.28 µm infrared from a small 2004 flyby region. Gray grid marks gaps. Values retain illumination and archive filtering; placement has several-kilometer uncertainty.
controls.title: Cassini VIMS regional spectra · 11 June 2004

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.description: Near-2.02 µm water-ice band depth relative to a linear 1.82–2.20 µm continuum, using 41 original VIMS pixels from one small region in Cassini’s 11 June 2004 flyby. This measures absorption strength, not ice abundance. Viewing angle, grain size and noise also affect the values; no photometric correction is applied. Archive noise filtering and local replacement remain; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Display colors saturate outside 0.1–0.3; original numerical values are retained. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps. The region is placed coarsely on the existing shape, with several-kilometer spatial uncertainty.
controls.summary: Near-2.02 µm ice absorption in a small, coarsely placed region. Gray grid marks gaps. Uncorrected values depend on viewing angle, grain size, noise and archive filtering; they do not measure ice abundance.
controls.title: Cassini VIMS regional water-ice absorption · 11 June 2004
